articles.summary: RENO, Nev., Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Plumas Bancorp (Nasdaq: PLBC) referred to herein as the ‘Company’, the parent company of Plumas Bank, today announced record earnings during the third quarter of 2026 of $11.4 million, or $1.64 per share, an increase of $6.2 million from $5.1 million or $0.74 per share, during the third quarter of 2025. Diluted earnings per share increased to $1.61 per share during the three months ended September 30, 2026, up from $0.73 per share during the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Return on average assets was 1.98% during the current quarter, up from 0.90% during the third quarter of 2025. Return on average equity increased to 16.7% during the current quarter, up from 8.5% during the third quarter of 2025. Net interest income increased by $1.3 million from $25.2 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025, to $26.5 million during the current quarter. articles.summary: Richard Belstock to continue with Plumas Bank as Special Assistant to the President QUINCY, California, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Plumas Bancorp (Nasdaq: PLBC), the holding company for Plumas Bank, announced today that Richard Belstock will retire from his position as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Plumas Bancorp and Plumas Bank effective January 1, 2027. The Board of Directors has appointed Kelsey Cassinelli, currently Senior Vice President and Principal Accounting Officer, to succeed Mr. Belstock as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Principal Financial Officer effective the same date. Following his retirement as Chief Financial Officer, Mr. Belstock will continue with Plumas Bank as Special Assistant to the President. In this role, he will support the President and the Bank's executive management team during the leadership transition and on other matters as requested. articles.summary: RENO, Nev., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Plumas Bancorp (Nasdaq: PLBC), the parent company of Plumas Bank (the “Bank”), today announced that the Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on Plumas Bancorp common stock of $0.33 per share, payable November 17, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 3, 2026. About Plumas Bancorp Plumas Bank is a subsidiary of Plumas Bancorp (NASDAQ: PLBC), a bank holding company headquartered in Reno, Nevada. Plumas Bank is a locally managed, award-winning community bank founded in 1980 and headquartered in Quincy, California. With 18 branch offices in Northeastern California and Northern Nevada, and loan production offices in California and southern Oregon, Plumas Bank is one of the top performing community banks in the country.
